description: Paid follow-up of prepare_pilot. From the buyer's dossier (as returned by prepare_pilot) and 1 to 5 robots chosen by the buyer (robot_ids, from list_robots), returns the full pre-pilot decision file in markdown: decision memo, the robots' announced facts, an evidence matrix per robot and per task with every dated observation behind it (failures included, with source, control mode and power), the gaps to close and who can close them, operating conditions and integration, the pilot specification, the questions to ask the manufacturer and the integrator, and the pilot self-assessment grid. Never recommends, ranks or chooses a robot, and computes no cost: the buyer decides. Requires the decision file access right, separate from robot access; without it the call returns a refusal with the link to request it.
name: build_pilot_decision_file
title: Pilot decision file (G.R.O.U.N.D., paid)
